scripts.checks: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.docs:dev: pnpm run docs:api && vitepress dev docs-site
scripts.docs:build: pnpm run docs:api && vitepress build docs-site
scripts.bindings:gen: cd crates/wickedways-core && TS_RS_EXPORT_DIR=../../generated/bindings cargo test --features ts export_typescript_bindings
scripts.bindings:check: pnpm run bindings:gen && git diff --exit-code generated/bindings
scripts.test:conformance: pnpm run wasm:build && vitest run --config conformance/vitest.config.ts
scripts.checks:phase0: cargo build -p wickedways-core --no-default-features && cargo test --workspace && pnpm run bindings:check && pnpm run test:conformance
